snippet.title: CHIMPANIK TRAILER
snippet.description:
Chimpanik is a chaotic multiplayer game where your voice is your only weapon.

Play as a completely ridiculous, armless cartoon monkey. Scream into your microphone to unleash powerful shockwaves, send your opponents flying, knock fruit out of trees, or launch yourself into the air.

Forget weapons and complicated loadouts. 
Just scream.

Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4967850/Chimpanik/
